short: the zaf role-brief and design-routine pack
is: The `teams` plugin (2.0.0): agent briefs for the instances the zaf spawner launches plus the design-session judgment lane, a SessionStart hook that prints `zaf doctor`, and five routines for the Engineer's design session.
conventions: nothing in the pack names a project: every project word comes from the project's ZAF.toml or the ticket
the build work runs through `zaf` verbs; the pack itself ships no scripts beyond the one hook command

fs.name: README.md
fs.role: the pack's manual: parts, role table, launching an instance, routines, what 2.0.0 retired

fs.name: agents/
fs.role: one brief per role, run as `teams:<role>`

fs.name: hooks/
fs.role: hooks.json: at session start in a ZAF.toml project, runs `zaf doctor` and prints its table

fs.name: skills/
fs.role: the design session's five slash commands

notes: this repo's ZAF.toml `[pack] path` points here: `zaf profile init` adds the repo as a marketplace and installs and enables teams@ways in each zaf profile
the only pack whose plugin.json sets a `version` (2.0.0), although the root README says the plugins carry no version number
the hook's matcher is `startup` only (not resume or clear) and it always exits 0, so it never blocks a session
the `zaf` binary these briefs and the hook drive is built from this repo's zaf/ crate; the interface page and keeper prompt they rely on live in zaf/assets/
needs Claude Code 2.1.296 or later because team.md sets `autoCompactWindow`
